lifecycle.note: This records a completed historical choice. It does not authorize recreating retired workflows or spending quota.

decision: GitHub Actions + Git blob transport + GitHub Artifacts were retained for the completed single Seedance video-generation investigations; this is not the current provider-release backend or an instruction to recreate probes.
trigger: The single-video text-to-video and image-to-video paths are already E2E verified, while earlier architecture expansion was driven partly by misattributed failures rather than demonstrated backend limits.

authorized_by: user instruction to use the connected GitHub repository and Volcengine API
asset_rights: current test reference image supplied/approved in the conversation
rights.scope: single-video generation and transfer in the user's repository/account context
invalidators: new assets have materially different rights constraints

verified_domain.image_to_video: single public GitHub-hosted JPEG reference, 5-second tested path
verified_domain.output_transfer: MP4 through GitHub Actions Artifact into ChatGPT

intent.user_goal: Allow GPT to generate a video through the user's API and return the actual asset to the conversation with minimal extra infrastructure.
intent.why_this_action_serves_the_goal: The existing path already produces the desired effect and has been tested end-to-end.

expected_state_changes: possible repository asset/metadata commits for reference inputs
quota_or_cost: GitHub Actions execution/storage within account limits
repository_mutations: workflow/request metadata and optional reference asset commits
public_or_private_asset_changes: reference image may become publicly fetchable when placed in this public repository
irreversible_effects: API quota already consumed by completed generations
Git history persists unless repository history is rewritten
cleanup_obligations: avoid committing sensitive/private reference assets to a public repository
remove test-only assets/workflows if they become unnecessary
effect.useful_output: actual generated MP4 delivered back into the ChatGPT conversation

epistemic_review.what_failure_would_falsify: a previously verified edge fails under unchanged premises and inside the verified domain, or a documented/runtime invalidator fires
epistemic_review.what_failure_would_not_falsify: failure of an untested model ID, larger file, different input modality, or alternative upload method
epistemic_review.if_retesting_is_needed_why: Only when a listed invalidator fires or the requested task leaves the verified domain.
